slot.brief: Evaluate (or show) a determinant whose rows/columns have entries built from sums, using row operations C1 → C1 + C2 + C3 to factor the determinant into a product.

verdicts.working: Factor 2r and 5s from rows 2 and 3. The remaining determinant is (3u-v-w)+v+w=3u, so the original determinant is 10rs·3u=30urs.

working:
$C_1\to C_1+C_2+C_3$: $$\begin{vmatrix}3u&v&w\\0&2r&0\\0&0&5s\end{vmatrix}=3u(2r)(5s)=30urs.$$

Independent check: Factor 2r and 5s from rows 2 and 3. The remaining determinant is (3u-v-w)+v+w=3u, so the original determinant is 10rs·3u=30urs.
solution:
Apply $C_1\to C_1+C_2+C_3$; the determinant is unchanged:
$$\begin{vmatrix}3u&v&w\\0&2r&0\\0&0&5s\end{vmatrix}=3u\cdot2r\cdot5s=30urs.$$

draft.distractor_notes: A: omits the factor $2$; B: introduces a sign error; D: uses $v$ instead of the resulting first-column entry.
